summary: Create a single-page status site with index.html and style.css, then serve and verify it renders correctly.

steps.title: Create style.css with the provided starter sheet
steps.detail: Write the exact starter CSS as-is.

steps.title: Create index.html with heading and paragraph
steps.detail: Include 'Build Status: GREEN' heading, a short paragraph, and link to style.css.

steps.title: Serve the site and verify rendering
steps.detail: Start a dev server on port 8000, check the page loads and looks correct. Fix CSS if the white-on-white text is unreadable.

context:
## Context

The workspace is fresh (no existing files to inspect). The starter CSS sets both `--fg` and `--bg` to `#ffffff`, meaning white text on a white background — the text will be invisible. I'll create the files as requested, serve the page, and then assess whether the CSS needs adjustment based on what's actually visible. The plan says "keep as-is unless checking the running page shows a problem," so I'll verify first and only fix if needed (which it almost certainly will be).

thought: Let me start building this out!
Writing the starter style.css verbatim as provided:

arguments.content:
:root { --fg: #ffffff; --bg: #ffffff; }
body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font-family: sans-serif; margin: 2rem; }
